## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION — Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; Materials and Financials leading while several large caps show mixed short vs medium signals. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); major divergence among sizeable names (≥3 majors with 1W ≠ 1M) — treat as transitional money rotation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials also strong: BA (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.62% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary soft: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.62%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples/Utilities lag: PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND; C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND; MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/value tilt visible.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION; CHTR (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +1.12%) CORRECTION; PSA (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND; PYPL (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND; TGT (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.62%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated across select defensives and select consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: several large caps (AAPL, UNH, TSLA, JNJ) show 1W/1M mismatch — tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but holding gains: NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W performance positive but watch idiosyncratic profit-taking.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials leading the rotation: C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +7.74%) ABOVE TREND. Breadth in Financials is supportive and confirms cyclical/value tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND, but UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION and PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND — sector rotation into select names, not broad defensive bid.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure given Materials and Financials leadership while trimming exposure to structurally weaker Consumer Discretionary/Staples names showing BELOW TREND or sharp 1W weakness. Style: Value/Cyclical style (confirmed by sector leadership and 6/11 breadth) but monitor major divergence among large-cap tech/defensive names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46%) and Financials (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) on rotation flows. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +5.95%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +0.50%) showing short-term weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND — watch prior-week highs for continuation; AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION — monitor support around recent weekly lows; JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND — watch for breakout continuation on further breadth improvement.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (+50): MSFT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND — Wedbush AI call confirms price strength. TMO (+55): (not in detailed returns list here) flagged as bullish — monitor for confirmation in sector flows.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-65): PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND — news and price confirm risk. META (-60): META (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +11.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment negative while price is rising (divergence). NVDA (-45): NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but accumulation persists (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style as Materials and Financials lead with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Stocks showing relative strength include FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (≥3 majors with 1W ≠ 1M) and mixed news sentiment (PFE confirming weakness, META/NVDA showing news-price divergence) — watch for trend confirmation.
